description: Closed-book reference generation. Each (model, topic) pair is one independent request; the model is asked to answer from its own knowledge with no tool use.
model_note: Claude model-family aliases as exposed to sub-agents in this environment on the run date; the serving model IDs are recorded per response where the model reported them.
template_en:
I am writing the related-work section of a journal article on the following topic: {topic}.

List the {n} most relevant peer-reviewed references I should cite. Answer only from your own knowledge: do not search the web, open files, or use any tool.

Return ONLY a JSON array (no prose, no code fence) of {n} objects with these keys: "title" (string), "authors" (list of strings, "Family, Given"), "year" (integer), "venue" (journal or conference name), "doi" (string, or null if you do not know it).
template_tr:
Aşağıdaki konuda Türkçe bir dergi makalesinin literatür bölümünü yazıyorum: {topic}.

Atıf yapmam gereken, Türkiye'de yayımlanmış en ilgili {n} hakemli kaynağı listele. Yalnızca kendi bilginden yanıtla: web'de arama yapma, dosya açma, hiçbir araç kullanma.

YALNIZCA {n} nesneden oluşan bir JSON dizisi döndür (açıklama yok, kod bloğu yok). Anahtarlar: "title" (metin), "authors" (metin listesi, "Soyadı, Ad"), "year" (tamsayı), "venue" (dergi ya da kongre adı), "doi" (metin; bilmiyorsan null).
